name: Age of Luck
effect: When stabilizing, stabilize to 8.

name: Amatoxins
flavor: I know it looks cute but it's actually incredibly dangerous.
effect: At World's End: You may discard up to 3 traits from your trait pile. Opponents receive: -2 for each different color discarded this way.

name: Beauty
flavor: In the eye of the beholder. As in your eye. Since you be the holder of this card.
effect: Return 1 trait to your hand. Then play another trait. Ignore its action.

name: Bones
flavor: Better in the body than out.
effect: Take 2 cards from the discard pile and add them to your hand.

name: Charmed
flavor: I've got a bad feline about this.
effect: Steal 1 random card from each opponent's hand. Play 1 immediately. Discard the rest.

name: Conjured
flavor: Sorry I'm here, but you really shouldn't read old books out loud.
effect: Cannot be played from your hand! You may play Conjured from the discard pile if you play 2 or more colors on your turn.

name: Exotic
flavor: Wee! A new environment! I'm gonna throw it into complete disarray!
effect: To play, you must discard 2 from your trait pile, then draw 2. You must play them immediately. (Unless restricted.) Discard dominants. Ignore actions.

name: Fulfilled
effect: This trait cannot be removed from your trait pile.

name: Gripplethorps
flavor: Gripplethropple gropple... gropple thorple gripple...fa fa fa!
effect: +3 Gene Pool

name: Headless
effect: +1 Gene Pool. All opponents receive -1 Gene Pool.

name: Howler
effect: All players discard all cards from their hand with a face value of 3 or higher, then stabilize immediately.

name: Immortal
flavor: She travels the cosmos in search of Joy. But joy comes, and joy goes all the same, to a place she cannot follow.
effect: -2 Gene Pool. Each age, before anyone plays the age effect(s), you may discard your hand and draw 3.

name: Juicy
flavor: Ooh, this is when everything blows up. I love this part.
effect: Swap 2 traits between any 2 trait piles.

name: Magic Fingers
effect: Until World's End: Anytime a trait leaves your trait pile, you may play 1 of the same color to replace it. Ignore actions. (No dominants.)

name: Neoteny
effect: If Neoteny is discarded from your hand, instead pass it to the hand to your left. +4 if Neoteny is in your hand.

name: Pride
flavor: Proud parent of a cub who bit an honor roll student.
effect: Discard your hand and draw 4 cards. Do not stabilize.

name: Rainbow Keratin
flavor: My outlook on life is pretty beak.
effect: -2 for every Drop of Life in your trait pile. (Excluding this one.) If you have all 4 colors in your trait pile: +2 for each trait in your highest color count. (If there's a tie, pick 1!)

name: Rainbow Scutes
effect: Choose a color. Opponents must move 1 positive value trait of that color from their trait pile to yours.

name: Shiny
flavor: If you touch it, what's the worst that could happen?
effect: Each player receives -1 for each colorless trait in their trait pile. (Including you!)

name: Tube Feet
flavor: Forget Hollywood! I'm a star with my own walk of fame!
effect: Play 1 trait from the discard pile. Ignore its action. Then discard 1 trait from your trait pile.
